steering_method_sources.finding: Contrastive Activation Addition uses signed coefficients and direct forward-pass activation addition, supporting SIGN_FLIP as a directional causal control.
Activation magnitude/sign changes affect effectiveness and faithfulness; gain must be calibrated rather than assumed.

Steering side effects are structured and often asymmetric; strongest off-target/counterexample evidence is required before promotion.
